head: codex/5359-v0918-preparation
title: [v0.91.8][WP-22] Review and schedule the v0.92 milestone plan
body:
Closes #5359

## Summary
- publishes a 36-WP v0.92 candidate plan while preserving `draft_pre_open`
- schedules the Agent Logic GitHub organization repository migration as WP-01A before substantive work
- requires all ten launch articles to be written in parallel and ready for editorial review under WP-24
- schedules all first ten Podcast Studio episodes as complete review-ready production packages under WP-24A
- schedules approved Runtime, distributed-polis, workflow, protocol, consumer, proof, cleanup, and release work
- records explicit technical deferrals and later publication/research backlog without dropping source pointers

## Validation
- v0.92 package validator PASS: 36 WPs and 24 source dispositions
- typed C-SDLC doctor PASS at reviewed generation 18
- current origin/main e0feeb810 is ancestral to the publication candidate
- diff hygiene PASS
- bounded GPT-5.5 exact-head review PASS with zero blockers at 9de77e34e

## Boundaries
- planning only; no v0.92 issue wave or implementation is opened here
- `danielbaustin/asksifu` remains personal and is excluded from the repository migration
- article and podcast completion require real review-ready work, not topic placeholders, demo audio, or publication claims
- capability taxonomy and MLX/OCI model distribution remain explicitly deferred
